props.name: className
props.comment: A class name to apply to the `<a>`, or to the `<span>` of a text value.

props.name: content
props.comment: Content to display as the link text. Defaults to the URL value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: The value shown when the one at `source` is `undefined`.

props.name: empty
props.comment:
The text shown when the value is empty. Translated through `i18n` when one
is given, printed as is otherwise. With none, the field renders nothing.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to read. Required: there is no record context to fall back on.

props.name: source
props.comment: Name of the property to display (dot/bracket path).

props.name: target
props.comment: Where the link opens. `_blank` with no `rel` gets `noopener noreferrer`.
